methods_quotes.q: The national baseline was calculated as the mean percentage of visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks for the preceding three seasons, plus two standard deviations.
Noninfluenza weeks are those in which <10% of laboratory specimens are positive for influenza.
The expected seasonal baseline proportion of P&I deaths reported by the 122 Cities Mortality Reporting System is projected using a robust regression procedure
The epidemic threshold is 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
